text.content: unit 9
Grammar n Expressions with infinitives
Use infinitives afterlt's +an adjective.
It's not good to argue.
It’s good to forgive someone. It’s not good to argue.
It's important to talk.
It’s important to talk. It’s never helpful to judge someone.
You can also use infinitives after \t’s + a noun phrase.
It’s a good idea to accept an apology. It’s not a good idea to criticize someone.
A Circle the infinitives for the best relationship advice. Then compare with a partner.
It's important to lie /to communicate in a relationship.
It’s helpful to share / to forget your feelings when you have a problem.
an nO & WN
It’s nice to gossip / to think about other people before making decisions.
It’s a good idea to judge / to meet new people.
It’s useful to discuss / to accept problems.
It’s not a good idea to argue / to compromise with your friends a lot.
B Complete the sentences with your own ideas. Use /t’s expressions.
Then discuss them.
